title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: About 600 m in six sections with a catwalk bridge; the intended route takes ~65 s.

verification.notes: Stands on the start roof; sprint clears the first low barrier and reaches the next red mast by 5 s. Red lattice masts with an electrical box closely match ref-2. Intended route ~65 s (first run inside the brief's 60-120 s).
